newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt condemns Israel blasts, calls for peace.
newsitem.headline: Egypt condemns Israel blasts, calls for peace.

text.p: Egypt on Wednesday condemned two suicide bomb attacks in Israel which killed 13 people and said the Middle East peace process must prevail.

State television said President Hosni Mubarak called Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to offer his condolences and condemn the attack, which Israeli police said was carried out by two Arab suicide bombers.
Foreign Minister Amr Moussa told reporters the attack "did not serve the cause of peace".

"Such incidents just add to the negative aspects surrounding the peace process...what is important in moments like these is confirmation that the peace process will continue," he said. "We call on all sides involved to keep the peace."
